issues.title: Add rover-direct operation without base station
issues.body:
Closes #80

  ## Summary

  Adds rover-direct operation without a separate base-station computer.

  - Runs the gateway, dashboard, rosbridge, XBEE simulation, and video relay on the
  Jetson
  - Uses the Jetson AP at `192.168.2.102`
  - Supports driving, steering, arm, gripper, video, and multiple browsers
  - Excludes GPS, autonomy, science, and Rocket M2
  - Adds a laptop-only Docker development environment

  ## Validation

  - Gateway tests: 52/52 passed
  - Dashboard typecheck, lint, and build passed
  - ROS build: 22 packages passed
  - ROS checks: 47 tests, 0 failures, 2 skipped

  ## Remaining

  - [ ] Validate video, driving, steering, arm, and gripper on the Jetson
  - [ ] Validate AP and systemd restart recovery
